body.intent: State as a constraint on daemon-plans-uncovered-proposals that an abandoned plan, plan-milestone or plan-review run's gated entry still covers the proposals it names (uncoveredProposals, internal/api/proposals.go:38-50, and the inbox's gated accept item, internal/api/inbox.go:353), refining Decision failed-plan-run-covers' 'an abandoned run covers nothing', which only the failed-run rule follows
